messages.author: b207b6a270f65efc
messages.subject: Re: MDIFF for multidimensional partial credit models
parts:
Hi there

As far as i know generalized partial credit model formulated by means of adjacent logits and graded model formulated by cumulative logits. so you can use graded model instead of generalized partial graded model for your analysis and than compute multidimensional difficulty index by MDIFF in mirt. generalized partial credit model estimate p(x=selection of category i for item), graded response model estimate p(x>= selection of category i or higher for item).

Best
